# rixl_organization (Resource)

Manages a Rixl organization tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rixl_organization" "acme" {
  name        = "Acme Media Corp"
  description = "Acme enterprise video and streaming organization"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)

### Optional

- `full_name` (String)
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `first_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_name` (String)
